confirmDialog.archiveBody: Do you really want to archive {label}{suffix}?
confirmDialog.restoreBody: Do you really want to restore {label}{suffix}?
confirmDialog.archiveNote: The record will be hidden but all data will be retained. You can restore it at any time.
confirmDialog.restoreNote: The record will become active again and visible across the platform.

hardDelete.title: Permanent deletion
hardDelete.computingImpact: Computing what this deletion would destroy…
hardDelete.previewFailed: Could not compute the deletion impact.
hardDelete.irreversibleBody: The record and everything listed below will be removed from the database for good. Only the deletion ledger entry will remain.
hardDelete.blockedBody: Protected records still reference this entity. Archive it instead, or handle these records first:
hardDelete.cascadeOverLimitBody: This deletion would cascade {count} documents, above the {limit} a single transaction can carry. Remove the derived records first, then try again.
hardDelete.noSideEffects: No related record is affected by this deletion.
hardDelete.ticketCountdown: This confirmation is valid for {seconds} more seconds.
hardDelete.ticketExpired: The confirmation window has expired. Close this dialog and start again.
hardDelete.passwordHelper: Re-enter your own password to prove it is really you.
hardDelete.reasonHelper: At least {min} characters. Stored permanently in the deletion ledger.

features.notActivatedBody: The “{module}” module is not part of this campus's offer. Contact your campus manager if you need access to it.
features.refusedDisabled: This module has just been deactivated for your campus. The page has been refreshed.
features.refusedReadOnly: This module is currently read-only for your campus: existing data stays visible, but no change can be saved.
features.frozenBody: The “{module}” module is currently read-only for your campus. Existing records stay fully visible; no change can be saved until it is switched back on.

pilot.title: Campus entitlement
pilot.planHelper: The tier sets the base offer. The decisions below are deviations from it.
pilot.planOpens: {count, plural, one {# module enters the offer} other {# modules enter the offer}}
pilot.planCloses: {count, plural, one {# module leaves the offer} other {# modules leave the offer}}
pilot.planClosesHelp: A module holding official records is refused rather than closed — freeze it instead.

state.notAllowed: Limited to “{state}” by the offer sold to this campus.

group.availableHelp: Sold to this campus. Switch each one on, freeze it, or take it out of the way.
group.unsoldHelp: Not part of the current plan. Only the platform administration can open them.
group.coreHelp: The platform is built on these — no one can switch them off, including the administration.

badge.coreHelp: Switching this off would remove the screen that switches things back on.
badge.untilHelp: On that date the module returns to its underlying state on its own.
badge.floored: Holds official records: it can be frozen, never switched off.

pilot.reasonHelper: At least {min} characters — shown to the campus and kept on the audit trail.
pilot.reasonOptional: Optional when switching a module back on.
pilot.untilHelper: Leave empty for a permanent decision.
pilot.pending: {count, plural, one {# pending change} other {# pending changes}}
pilot.loadError: The entitlement of this campus could not be loaded.
pilot.auditFolded: Existing configuration carried over automatically — not decided by this operator.
pilot.managerSubtitle: Switch off what your campus does not use: every module left on is a menu entry your staff will click once.

ai.notSubscribed: The AI module is off for this campus. The values below are kept and apply again the moment it is switched back on.

ai.llmProfileHelper: Model profile used by the AI service for this campus.
ai.budgetError: The budget must be a whole number, zero or more.
ai.featuresHelper: Only the deviations from the tier are stored, so a campus follows the grid when its plan changes.

estate.title: Modules across the estate
estate.subtitle: Every campus, its plan, and what it can actually use. Select a row to change it.
estate.unconfiguredHelp: No entitlement was ever set for this campus, so it currently has every module — paid ones included.
